entity: US ICE detainers: share issued on people with a criminal conviction, FY23 vs FY26 (Oct-Mar both years)
what_we_add: the exact fall 43% to 16% on matching months, with FY25 at 33% - no source states the FY23-to-FY26 trend numbers
why: Deportation Data Project (2026-09-08) states the same finding in words: detainers rose in 2026 by increasingly targeting people without convictions - conviction share falling, same direction. TRAC's 28% point figure (Jan-Feb 2025) fits our 33% FY25 line. TRAC's 97% Biden-era number counts charged OR convicted, a different measure, so no contradiction.
